title: Digital service catalogue and lead services
invariants: Digital service discovery and new enquiries are governed by the published Website digital capability.
Service, package and add-on prices are server-owned and enquiry selections retain immutable price/version snapshots.
Public submission is idempotent and rate-limited using a database-serialized hourly fingerprint bucket.
Reference files are byte/type/size/digest validated and private storage identities are never exposed publicly.
Consultation preferences are timezone-safe and external calendar integration remains disabled by default.
Mode disablement blocks new digital leads without deleting existing request/history records.
Lead assignment, follow-up, notes and status changes are permission-scoped and append-only audited.
